can_view_all_employees.label: View all employees
can_view_all_employees.description: Allows viewing all company employees without editing them.

can_view_employee_details.label: View employee details
can_view_employee_details.description: Allows opening an employee card and viewing their personal details.

can_add_employee.label: Add employee
can_add_employee.description: Allows creating new employee accounts in the system.

can_edit_employee.label: Edit employee
can_edit_employee.description: Allows changing details of an existing employee (name, department, phone, etc.).

can_delete_employee.label: Delete employee
can_delete_employee.description: Allows removing employees from the system including all their data.

can_reset_employee_password.label: Reset employee password
can_reset_employee_password.description: Allows creating a temporary password for an employee who lost access.

can_manage_departments.label: Manage departments
can_manage_departments.description: Allows creating, editing, and deleting departments in the organization.

can_export_employees.label: Export employee list
can_export_employees.description: Allows downloading the employee list to an external file.

can_create_schedule.label: Create work schedule
can_create_schedule.description: Allows creating a new weekly work schedule.

can_edit_schedule.label: Edit work schedule
can_edit_schedule.description: Allows changing an existing work schedule before approval.

can_approve_schedule.label: Approve work schedule
can_approve_schedule.description: Allows approving a work schedule submitted by a department head.

can_publish_schedule.label: Publish work schedule
can_publish_schedule.description: Allows approving and publishing a work schedule directly to employees.

can_manage_schedule.label: Shift settings
can_manage_schedule.description: Allows managing shift types, hours per day, and schedule period. Default: system owner only — can be granted to assistant or branch manager.

can_view_leave.label: View leave requests
can_view_leave.description: Allows opening leave management and viewing requests in the branch.

can_approve_leave.label: Approve leave
can_approve_leave.description: Allows approving a leave request at management level.

can_reject_leave.label: Reject leave
can_reject_leave.description: Allows rejecting a leave request at management level.

can_edit_leave_balance.label: Edit leave balance
can_edit_leave_balance.description: Allows updating balances and monthly accrual rate for an employee. Not automatic for manager/assistant — only when granted by platform owner.

can_view_breaks.label: View employees on break
can_view_breaks.description: Allows seeing which employees are currently on break.

can_manage_breaks.label: Manage breaks
can_manage_breaks.description: Allows creating, editing, and deleting break requests.

can_view_tasks.label: View tasks
can_view_tasks.description: Allows viewing all tasks in the system.

can_create_tasks.label: Create tasks
can_create_tasks.description: Allows creating new tasks and assigning employees.

can_edit_tasks.label: Edit tasks
can_edit_tasks.description: Allows updating details of an existing task.

can_delete_tasks.label: Delete tasks
can_delete_tasks.description: Allows deleting tasks from the system.

can_approve_tasks.label: Approve tasks (when creator is department head)
can_approve_tasks.description: Allows approving completion of a task created by a department head.

can_view_messages.label: View messages
can_view_messages.description: Allows opening the communications center and reading received messages.

can_send_messages.label: Send messages
can_send_messages.description: Base permission to send messages from within the system.

can_send_message_employee.label: Send message to employee
can_send_message_employee.description: Allows sending a personal message to a single employee.

can_send_message_department.label: Send message to department
can_send_message_department.description: Allows sending a message to all employees in a department.

can_send_message_all.label: Send message to all employees
can_send_message_all.description: Allows sending a message to all company employees.

can_manage_communications.label: Manage communications center
can_manage_communications.description: Allows editing and deleting others' messages, and viewing the activity log.

can_view_read_receipts.label: View read receipts
can_view_read_receipts.description: Allows seeing who read messages and who has not yet.

can_view_reports.label: View reports
can_view_reports.description: Allows viewing management reports in the system.

can_export_reports.label: Export reports
can_export_reports.description: Allows downloading reports to an external file.

can_manage_employee_of_month.label: 🏆 Manage Employee of the Month
can_manage_employee_of_month.description: Allows selecting outstanding employees for the month, updating selection reason, uploading photos, and deleting records.

can_manage_morning_board.label: 📢 Manage Main Board content
can_manage_morning_board.description: Allows adding, editing, ordering, and deleting Main Board items for the branch — images, videos, and announcements. Can only be granted to branch manager or assistant.

can_create_custody.label: Add equipment
can_create_custody.description: Allows adding new equipment items (e.g. Equipment 1, Equipment 2). Can be granted to branch or assistant manager.

can_edit_custody.label: Edit equipment
can_edit_custody.description: Allows changing name, order, and reminders of existing equipment items.

can_delete_custody.label: Disable/delete equipment
can_delete_custody.description: Allows disabling an unused equipment item.

can_return_custody.label: Return equipment on behalf of employee
can_return_custody.description: Allows returning equipment taken by another employee. Branch manager can always — this permission is mainly for assistant manager.

can_receive_custody_alerts.label: Receive equipment alerts
can_receive_custody_alerts.description: Receives an alert when an employee ends a shift but still holds equipment, or before midnight.

can_configure_custody.label: Equipment system settings
can_configure_custody.description: Allows updating reminder times, daily log reset, and midnight alerts.

can_view_custody_daily_log.label: View daily log
can_view_custody_daily_log.description: Allows viewing the daily equipment usage log (resets per branch settings).

can_run_custody_monthly_report.label: Monthly equipment report
can_run_custody_monthly_report.description: Allows generating a monthly report and archiving equipment data.

can_manage_permissions.label: Manage permissions
can_manage_permissions.description: Allows setting which permissions each user has.

can_manage_company_settings.label: Manage company settings
can_manage_company_settings.description: Allows updating company name, logo, colors, and contact details.

can_view_activity_log.label: View activity log
can_view_activity_log.description: Allows viewing the history of actions in the system.

can_manage_users.label: Manage users
can_manage_users.description: Allows managing user accounts and their roles.
